clips.title: The story
paras: In the Valley of Trials, Zureetha Fargaze watches for threats to young Horde recruits. Alongside Foreman Thazz'ril in Durotar, she sends them to uncover and root out the Burning Blade cult hidden in the valley.

Zureetha Fargaze watches for dangers beyond the work and discipline Foreman Thazz'ril oversees. The Burning Blade cult has secretly entered the Valley of Trials, corrupted lesser demons, and gathered strength in the nearby Burning Blade Coven. She sends untested adventurers to recover medallions from the cultists, confirm their presence, and disrupt their early efforts. Then she directs seasoned recruits farther into Durotar.
